name: NGC 5559, host of SN 2001co (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5559, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2001co-hubble
story: New stars are being born along the spiral arms of NGC 5559, which sweep out around a bright central bulge. In 2001 a calcium-rich supernova, 2001co, flared in its disk near those star-forming regions.

claims.text: NGC 5559 is a spiral galaxy with star-forming spiral arms around a bright bulge
Calcium-rich supernova 2001co occurred in the disc of NGC 5559 near star-forming regions, observed in 2001
